steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Guh...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Ink Spirits. Ink... Spirit. What a beautiful name.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Saga is such an bright girl.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Again and again, she protects the things she knows can't be damaged. I wonder if that means they will grow sick of this pointless exercise and give up on that righteousness one of these days?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I suppose she will. After all, if you can restore broken porcelain, then it's not going to be much of a heartbreak at all to see it shatter into pieces.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: You might even come to enjoy the feeling of breaking it.

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: ...Gaa?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: But do we have to go that far...? Human nature is no match for these trials and tribulations.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Are you watching, Dusk?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: You are such a meanie... I only hope don't mind what I have planned.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: —Hff!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My benefactors, we've done it at last!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Forgive me for throwing cold water, but with no end in sight to our daily scuffles with the monsters, surely you agree with me our search for the way out is making hardly any progress?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Saga said she'd come up with something.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: And so we will take on the Ink Spirits here day after day? This hardly feels like the best use of our time...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: It's no big deal to me.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Just think of it as a way to hone our techniques.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: —Lava, mate.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hmm? What's up?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Go on?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: The Arts you used back there looked just a little bit dangerous.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: See? You burned down quite a few stores.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: And you, Nothing, mate.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You pretended you didn't see that small Ink Spirit rush toward town, did you?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I thought you would have no trouble taking care of it.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: No, you thought, 'If something goes wrong, everything will just go back to the way it was tomorrow.'

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I... I can't deny I did... I know what you mean, but...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Today's the seventh day.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I'm not trying to give you a hard time. When you pointlessly protect the same objectives day after day, you're bound to feel that way sooner or later.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Remember Rim Billiton, though... Don't ever forget what that bloody month taught us.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: War can wear you down mentally, so we need to be alert.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Kroos...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Sorry... Mate, you know that I've always...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: It's okay. I understand.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: We'll be fine. We'll get out of here and make it back to Rhodes Island in one piece.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Alright~ Be sure to treat me to some Columbian coffee once we're back.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Is Saga still in the room?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I stole a glance before leaving this morning. It has been seven days since she started meditating... My benefactor, if we die of starvation or thirst in this painting, do you suppose that... we might truly die?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: No idea. All Saga said before she shut herself in was something like, 'Leave it to me...'

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: She's the one who understands most what's going on in the painting. We don't have any other choice, or are you volunteering to take a stroll inside the other scrolls, just like what she's doing?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: No, no, no. I'm hardly as determined as the master. I'm afraid I would find myself distracted and never able to return.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: There just isn't much we can do for her until something happens on her end.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: So this is where you've been.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Dawn? What's the matter?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I wanted to remind you to never stray from your true conscience.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I once told Saga, 'When deceit is taken for truth, the truth is yet unreal. When naught is taken for aught, there is yet but nil.'

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Right, where is she?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: She's been meditating in the room for days.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I see. She wants to wake up.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: There have been very few people who managed to wake up from the scroll on their own volition. Actually, I should say there has never been anyone who has managed to do it.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: But... maybe.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Ms. Lava, have you heard of 'firecrackers?'

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: It's a time-honored tradition in Yan. As you can imagine, it was at first—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: —For warding off ancient monsters?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Oh... I thought you were born outside of Yan? You know your Yan traditions well.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Well, let's just say I've got a friend...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Right, now I remember...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Please don't remember.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: This is straight out of 'Ancient Forge,' isn't it? I remember something about Nian being scared of firecrackers. The Dark Devastator in the end used cannons as well—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: —Aahhhh, I can't hear you!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Dawn! What do firecrackers have to do with this situation?!

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Hm? Oh... I was going to say the Ink Spirits are actually scared of firecrackers.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: If we hang some firecrackers up at the village's entrance, they will naturally stay away.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Really?!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Wow, what a lifesaver! My back has been hurting me the past day and a half! At last, I can take the day off from looking for monsters!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Now, without further ado, let us take to the market—

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: You won't find them in the market.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: —Quite right. How do we procure some, then?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Well, there is a way...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Do you know why firecrackers are called as such?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Because the earliest Yan people thought to commemorate their fallen liege's exploits by setting bamboo on fire, and memorialize the great war with its crackling sounds.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You know your stuff.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Haha, I'm merely well-read on the subject.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: There you have it.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Let's give them a surprise unlike any other.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: This one will do?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: What a fine bamboo tree. Would be a waste to cut it down!

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: It will grow anew tomorrow.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Showing no mercy to the flora, are we...?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I'm back! Is this enough?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: The more the better.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: The Umbrella-Boiler is such a nice guy. He gave us all this bamboo for nothing.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: If you're worried about taking the bamboo, I'll pay the storyteller a visit and give him our thanks. No one ever comes back to my pawn shop for their items. I could just give him everything as a sign of our gratitude.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Are you sure about that?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: It will all be mine again tomorrow.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hm, I've seen firewood burn and crackle up pretty good, but does bamboo do that too?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Supposedly, wet bamboo after the rain gives the most thunderous pops. The only problem is it never rains here.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Right, just like this... Make a kind of stove with the mud...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Now, as for the fire—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: —Let me try.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Be careful with the heat. It's a bit more finicky than it seems.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I-I'll try my best...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My benefactor! They are here!

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Now!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Mph—

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh... gkhaa—?!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: We did it! They're dazed!

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkhaa—!!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: They ran? Are they truly afraid of it?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Did it really work...? Why is that...?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: We'll have to ask Nian—

steps.name: Storyteller
steps.text: ...Nian?
